text:
Marta Lee: quick question — for on‑prem packaging, can we make activation fully atomic from the operator's POV?
Samir Patel: atomic how? swap-in single manifest apply + activate step?
Marta Lee: yeah. idea is: operator downloads layers, verify signatures, stage files, then one RPC that flips a captainy-style activation marker so everything becomes live. either everything activates or nothing.
Jia Chen: we tried similar but hit partial-apply on low-disk nodes. the operator may OOM while unpacking a big model shard and then the container restarts midapply. need a safety plan.
Ryan O'Neill: we should separate "fetch+verify" from "apply" and make "apply" idempotent. also have a two-phase commit with activation window: APPLY -> READY -> ACTIVATE. ACTIVATE is atomic marker write.
Linh Tran: operator teams prefer a single reconcile loop. adding 3 states is OK but API must be simple. proposal: POST /v1/packages/:id/stage -> returns staging-id. POST /v1/staging/:staging-id/activate -> atomic activate.
Marta Lee: that maps to product: user expects zero-downtime and a clear rollback path. if activate fails, operator should be able to revert to previous symlink snapshot.
Samir Patel: rollback via symlink swap is good. downside: big disk overhead for snapshot copies. we can use copy-on-write where available, else fallback to stream-apply revert.
Jia Chen: also need signer escrow for air-gapped. ops want operator to hold signing keys escrowed and short-lived. suggest: activation requires a signature timestamped within the last N minutes. ops-bot: Reminder: we already have KMS integration for Private deployments. :robot_face:
Marta Lee: can we add an allowlist for activation origins (operator vs admin tool)? want to avoid accidental local activate by non-admin process.
Ryan O'Neill: support RBAC on the Activate endpoint. simplest: bearer token scopes: staging:write, staging:activate. operator gets both; agents (less trusted) only staging:write.
Linh Tran: folks, what about partial-compatibility when model layout changes? e.g. node A has old shard layout, node B new layout. activation must fail cluster-wide if any node cannot satisfy layout.
Samir Patel: agree. activation should consult per-node readiness and require quorum. default quorum = 100% for on-prem but allow configurable grace (e.g., 95%) for large clusters.
Jia Chen: we should expose a dry-run API that simulates activation and returns per-node readiness reasons. UI/CLI can call it before ACTIVATE. example: `POST /v1/staging/:id/dryrun` -> returns json with node ids and status.
Marta Lee: add telemetry: activation timestamp, node-success-count, checksum of active manifest. useful for audits.
Ryan O'Neill: failure modes: 1) mid-apply node crash -> operator marks node Unhealthy and signals rollback if below quorum. 2) checksum mismatch -> reject activation. 3) low-disk on many nodes -> abort activation and surface remediation steps.
Linh Tran: implement a short activation lease: activation must complete within X minutes or it auto-aborts to prevent half-installed states lingering. default X=30. ops-bot: Suggested playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-activation (private) :link:
Samir Patel: implement activation marker as an atomic rename of a directory or symlink swap. POSIX rename is atomic. on Windows we'll need a different path (replaceFile). include fallback for older filesystems.
Jia Chen: for air-gapped upgrades, we should bundle a small "activator" binary signed separately. operator runs it with staging-id and does the final atomic flip. keeps main operator simple and reduces privileged surface.
Marta Lee: nice. keep activator minimal and auditable. make activator accept `--staging-id` and `--dry-run`. show sample: ```bash
./activator --staging-id=abcd1234 --activate
```
Ryan O'Neill: security: activator should drop privileges before applying. also verify signatures again on local files to protect against post-download tampering.
Linh Tran: ops do want an emergency bypass: `force-activate` with extra audit headers, but gated behind enterprise policy and multi-signer approval.
Samir Patel: we need better observability: per-node apply logs streamed to console and retained for 30d. add `logs_url` in activation response.
Marta Lee: ok next steps: 1) draft operator API PR with staging/activate/dryrun/rollback endpoints; 2) activator design doc for air-gapped; 3) implement atomic marker by rename + lease timeout.
Jia Chen: I'll start the activator doc and include sample JSON payloads.
Ryan O'Neill: i'll sketch the operator API and quorum semantics.
Linh Tran: i'll draft the RBAC scopes and enterprise bypass flow.
Marta Lee: great. thanks all :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Deployment note: created issue #ENG-9412 for operator API work and linked this thread.
